title: Amethyst Expansion
description: This is a vanilla friendly mod to expand the use of amethyst. It adds new amethyst blocks, amethyst brick blocks, new recipes to craft them, and is fully vanilla friendly!
body: This is a vanilla friendly mod to expand the use of amethyst. It adds new amethyst blocks, amethyst brick blocks, new recipes to craft them, and is fully vanilla friendly! (Blocks included are new stairs, slabs, walls, fences, fence gates, and new Amethyst Brick Block)
